visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three individuals are seated on a sofa in a studio setting. A woman in a red and blue traditional-style robe sits centrally, flanked by two men. The man on the left wears a red sports jersey, while the man on the right is in a green t-shirt. They are all reacting with exaggerated excitement, cheering, and laughing with open mouths and expressive hand gestures. In front of them, a table holds several cards or documents. A digital baseball scoreboard overlay is visible at the bottom of the frame, indicating a game between 'Weichuan Dragons' and 'Uni-Lions'. The lighting is bright and professional studio style. (2) The scene cuts to a closer, slightly overhead view of a larger group of people sitting around a mahjong table indoors. An elderly man in a brown vest is prominent, interacting with the mahjong tiles with his hands. Several other young men and women, including the three from the previous scene, are visible around him, laughing and filming with their smartphones. The table is covered with white and green mahjong tiles. The background is a simple indoor room with white walls and posters. The mood is casual, chaotic, and festive.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic skit using the 'Expectation vs. Reality' trope. It humorously suggests that while people imagine a specific Taiwanese sports broadcast to be intensely professional, the 'reality' is a group of people casually and boisterously playing Mahjong together. It relies on local cultural tropes and high-energy group dynamics.
